findings.source: Peace Palace Library (The Hague) — WorldCat Discovery (peacepalace.on.worldcat.org)
findings.status: RETIRED 2026-09-02 at the operator's instruction, after the first live run (see live_2026_09_02): the client (src/sources/worldcat.ts), its fixtures and the probe canary were removed outright — no dormant code, as with EUIPO and ÚPV. What was learned stays here; the way back in would be OCLC's official WorldCat Search API with a WSKey issued through the library.
findings.captured: HAR of a live browser session, 2026-09-02 (Edge/Chromium, sanitized export: no Cookie/Set-Cookie/Authorization headers), advanced search with two result pages

access.auth: UNCERTAIN. Every SPA request carries three headers: Oclc-Apik (64 hex chars) and Oclc-Apin (40 decimal digits) — BOTH DIFFERENT ON EVERY REQUEST (42 distinct pairs in 42 requests), i.e. a per-request signature computed in the SPA bundle; and api-token, a JWE (header {"cty":"jwt","enc":"A256CBC-HS512","alg":"dir"}) constant across the two /api/search calls, i.e. a session token. Their origin is not in the capture (no page-load entry). The site sits behind Cloudflare (CF-RAY FRA).
access.detail:
SEARCH (verbatim, entries 0 and 42): GET /api/search?queryString=<q>&databaseList=10007,10025,10052,10058,10306,10896,11162,11537,2795,3313,3560,3577,3578,3583,3590,3962,3963,4023,4052,4056,638&sortKey=BEST_MATCH&clusterResults=true&groupVariantRecords=false&bookReviews=off&year=2021..2025&content=fullText&idDetect=true&citeDetect=true[&page=2]. Request headers: Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*; Accept-Language: en; Referer: the /search?… page with the same parameters.
queryString is WorldCat's index syntax as the advanced form composes it: kw:(keword) AND ti:(title) OR au:(author) — index labels kw/ti/au/su; the backend's echoed queryOptimization.originalQuery shows the `year` parameter rewritten into `( (yr:2021..2025) )`. `content=fullText` = the 'Full Text' content facet (other facet values seen: openAccess, peerReviewed, notFic).
RESPONSE: {databaseList[], locale, numberOfRecords (12279), parsedQuery[{field,text,boolean,start,end}], partialResult (bool), providerSearchRequest (an internal SRU 'worldcat-plus' URL — the engine is SRU/CQL), queryExpansion{}, queryOptimization{originalQuery,…}, records[10], searchResultsType: NORMAL}. Page size is fixed at 10; page 2 = records 11–20.
RECORD fields seen (books only): oclcNumber, titleObject{data}, authors[{firstNameObject, lastNameObject, primary, type, relatorList}], date, publishers[{data}], itemType, itemTypeDisplay, language, isbns[], digitalObjectIdentifiers[], summariesObjectList[{data}], contentsObjects[{note, noteObject{data}}], subjectGroups[{bibSubjects[…]}], physicalDescription, edition, workId, links[{url,label?,accessMethod}], opacLink, peerReviewed, openAccess, remoteDatabase, databaseId, sourceCollection, genres[], heldByInstitutionName. Record permalink: https://peacepalace.on.worldcat.org/oclc/<oclcNumber>.
access.fixtures: removed with the client (were tests/fixtures/worldcat/search-page-{1,2}.json — verbatim envelope, first 3 records of each page)

access.auth: SimpleSAMLphp IdP of the library (AuthState → spentityid=https://shib.oclc.org/shibboleth): OCLC's Shibboleth SP, i.e. WorldCat Discovery sign-in via the library's own IdP with a username and password; the proxy host in every licensed access link was peacepalace.idm.oclc.org/login?url=…
access.detail: Only the login-page URL and the proxy host are known (user-supplied / from the capture). Never exercised: the reader-login layer was removed before any live sign-in.

Article records' field names — the capture holds books only.
findings.live_2026_09_02: From the production deployment (fra1, IP 3.125.160.75): GET /api/search unsigned → HTTP 403 in ~50 ms with Cloudflare's 'Sorry, you have been blocked' page (Ray ID a34ba4d969938ff2) — a WAF block of the deployment's request before any OCLC code runs, so the signing headers are moot from this address.

findings.source: Univerzita Karlova — UKAŽ, Primo VE (cuni.primo.exlibrisgroup.com, vid 420CKIS_INST:UKAZ)
findings.captured: Three HARs of live browser sessions, 2026-09-02 (sanitized exports): one advanced search that matched nothing; the start of the CAS login (idp.cuni.cz → cas.cuni.cz login form, no credentials posted); a signed-in Primo session (159 entries: the SPA after CAS calls GET /primaws/suprimaLogin/loginExtSuccess → 302 and GET /primaws/rest/pub/loginJwtCache/<session id>?vid=420CKIS_INST:UKAZ → 200, i.e. it obtains a USER JWT that the searches then carry — not needed by the tool, whose guest calls answer the same catalogue).

access.auth: NONE needed for search and record display (verified live from the deployment: the pnxs calls answer HTTP 200 without any Authorization header). The client still asks GET /primaws/rest/pub/institution/420CKIS_INST/jwt?isGuest=true&lang=cs&targetUrl=…&viewId=420CKIS_INST:UKAZ (from memory of the SPA, never exercised) and retries with Authorization: Bearer <jwt> should a 401/403 ever come.
access.detail:
SEARCH (verbatim, entry 0): GET /primaws/rest/pub/pnxs?acTriggered=false&blendFacetsSeparately=false&citationTrailFilterByAvailability=true&disableCache=false&getMore=0&inst=420CKIS_INST&isCDSearch=false&lang=cs&limit=10&mode=advanced&newspapersActive=true&newspapersSearch=false&offset=0&otbRanking=false&pcAvailability=false&q=<q>&qExclude=&qInclude=&rapido=false&refEntryActive=false&rtaLinks=true&scope=MyInst_and_CI&searchInFulltextUserSelection=true&skipDelivery=Y&sort=rank&tab=Everything&vid=420CKIS_INST:UKAZ
q syntax (verbatim): any,contains,jakekolivpole,AND;title,contains,nazev,OR;title,equals,nazevjepresne,NOT;creator,contains,autorneaobsahuje,AND;sub,contains,predmet,AND;issn,contains,ISSN,AND;lang,exact,cze,AND;dr_s,exact,20250101,AND;dr_e,exact,20260101,AND — one `field,operator,value,BOOL` clause per form row, then the pre-filters lang / dr_s / dr_e in the same syntax. Paging: offset + limit (10).
RESPONSE: {beaconO22, info{totalResultsLocal, totalResultsPC, total, first, last}, highlights{…}, docs[], timelog{…}}. docs[] follow Primo's PNX layout (context L/PC, pnx{control{recordid,sourceid}, display{type,title,creator,contributor,creationdate,publisher,language,ispartof,subject,description,contents,identifier,oa}, addata{doi,isbn,issn,jtitle,volume,issue,spage,date,abstract}, links{linktorsrc,openurl,openurlfulltext ($$T templates)}}, delivery{link[{linkType,linkURL}], availability[]}).
RECORD (verified live): GET /primaws/rest/pub/pnxs/{L|PC}/{recordid}?vid=420CKIS_INST:UKAZ&lang=cs&search_scope=MyInst_and_CI → one doc with pnx + delivery (holdings). display.contents carries the whole table of contents of catalogue books, display.description the abstract of CDI articles — the two fields doctrine_get_document returns whole (the search cuts them to snippets).
Record page: https://cuni.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=<recordid>&vid=420CKIS_INST:UKAZ&lang=cs&context=<L|PC>.

access.auth: Primo → Shibboleth IdP idp.cuni.cz (SAML2 Redirect SSO) → external authn → CAS (cas.cuni.cz). CAS form (captured): POST /cas/login?service=<idp callback> with username, password, execution (a long flow token from the page), _eventId=submit; an alternative e-Identity (NIA) button.
access.detail: Not used by any tool: the guest search already covers the UK catalogue and the Central Discovery Index, and the reader-login layer that would have needed it was removed (next finding).

unverified: dr_e as YYYY1231 for the 'to' year (the capture shows dr_s=20250101, dr_e=20260101 for the user's range; the tool writes an inclusive year end).
The guest-JWT endpoint (never needed so far — pnxs answers without a token).
findings.live_2026_09_02: From the production deployment: pnxs answers HTTP 200 WITHOUT any Authorization header (canary and three searches); 'genocida' = 443 local + 10 346 Central Discovery Index records; the full-display endpoint answers 200 with the full record and holdings. Seen in the records: display.contents (table of contents of catalogue books), display.identifier as '$$CISBN$$V…' or 'DOI: …'/'ISSN: …', display.oa ['free_for_read'], delivery.link thumbnails with RELATIVE linkURLs ('api/image/…') and a bare linkType 'thumbnail', pnx.links openurl/openurlfulltext as '$$T…' templates (no URL), delivery.availability ['fulltext'] / ['available_in_library'].

findings.source: Full texts of the literature and the reader login — REMOVED 2026-09-02
findings.status: REMOVED at the operator's instruction ('kašleme na pdfka … stačí přečíst abstrakt'): the layer that fetched open-access copies (Unpaywall + doi.org + publisher/repository pages, PDF text via unpdf, HTML via htmlToText, SSRF guard on every hop) and opened licensed works through the university's EZproxy with a reader login stored sealed on /ucet (AES-256-GCM under CREDENTIALS_SECRET in Clerk private metadata; browser-like walker through CAS) was deleted whole — src/sources/fulltext.ts, src/sources/library-login.ts, src/sources/shared/publicurl.ts, src/mcp/credentials.ts, app/ucet, the unpaywall/pdf/cas fixtures and tests, the unpdf dependency, the /ucet footer link and proxy matcher, the unpaywall probe canary. Orientation in the literature is served by the record's whole abstract and table of contents (doctrine_get_document); the text of a work is the reader's to open from the record link.
findings.captured: Unpaywall: 12 verbatim responses inside the WorldCat HAR (api.unpaywall.org/v2/<doi>?email=…: doi, is_oa, oa_status gold|hybrid|bronze|green|closed, best_oa_location{url,url_for_pdf,url_for_landing_page,license,version,host_type}, oa_locations[]; 404 for an unknown DOI). EZproxy of Charles University: host CONFIRMED by the operator's HAR of an EBSCO session (36 entries) — the publisher is served from rewritten subdomains research-ebsco-com.ezproxy.is.cuni.cz and logon-ebsco-zone.ezproxy.is.cuni.cz, i.e. the proxy base is https://ezproxy.is.cuni.cz (the value the removed code carried from memory); the PDF itself came from content.ebscohost.com/cds/retrieve?content=<opaque token> as application/pdf — the publisher's own delivery host with a short-lived token, not a URL a server could derive from the record. CAS login form: username, password, hidden execution + _eventId=submit (was tests/fixtures/cas-login-form.html).
findings.live_2026_09_02: Before the removal: api.unpaywall.org from fra1 did not answer within 12 s on three tries around 09:56 UTC, then answered HTTP 200 in 322 ms at 10:04 UTC — a transient outage, not a block. No live sign-in through the proxy was ever attempted.

decisions: One source, UKAŽ: doctrine_search (query/queries ≤ 3 variants, title, author, subject, language, years; limit ≤ 20 with brief records above 10; page walks the catalogue's fixed pages of 10 via pageWindow/sliceWindow; every variant gets an equal round-robin share of the page) and doctrine_get_document {id} (one record whole).
The Peace Palace Library (WorldCat Discovery) was retired after the first live run: Cloudflare blocks the deployment's address before any OCLC code runs. No dormant client is kept (EUIPO/ÚPV rule).

No full texts: the literature tools return catalogue records — the search with snippets of abstract and contents, the record tool with both whole. The download/PDF/reader-login layer was built, reviewed and then removed at the operator's request; nothing of it stays switched off in the code, and nothing personal beyond the account is stored any more.
No sort/format filters: their URL parameters were not captured and a guessed one would silently answer a different question.
